vector_morph.method: paired closed contours; component-local nonzero winding
vector_morph.extraction: marching squares at SDF byte threshold 127.5; bilinear crossings; cell-mean saddle choice
vector_morph.coordinates: local glyph coordinates in [-0.5,0.5], Y up; 16-bit unsigned xy
vector_morph.packing: two RGBA pixels per vertex; all-255 source marks break, target x=0 outer or x=65535 hole
vector_morph.component_matching: outer then parent-local holes; arc samples preserve sharp corners; cyclic phase favours fewer folds
vector_morph.birth_death: interior point anchors; an unmatched component and its holes contract together; no opacity ramp
vector_morph.fill: union of outer coverage clipped by its holes; no independent hole or degenerate-point AA
vector_morph.endpoints: original SDF; 2.5% endpoint interval reconciles polygon sampling and SDF AA
vector_morph.limitations: bounded polygon approximation, not native Manim curve topology or pixel-equivalent Transform

geometry.provenance: original geometric star, shaped wind ribbons and 24 persistent filled contour fragments
geometry.transition: the same filled geometric fragments break from the whole star, travel continuously and return along arcs

chapters.title: 如果星光散落
chapters.action: 左上与右下两行大宋体先后淡入并展开轮廓，青金风带托住文字；第一句收拢为星核。

chapters.title: 一束风与一颗星
chapters.action: 有宽窄变化的风带托起清晰的大星核，双层几何瓣片构成可辨认的完整形。

chapters.title: 光碎了，名字还在
chapters.action: 明亮流星拖着长尾划过；43秒撞击，完整星核拆为24片有面积的几何碎片。

chapters.title: 每一片都有归处
chapters.action: 同一批碎片分层散开，在横跨画面的风带中旋转漂流，保留各自轮廓与身份。

chapters.title: 风听见回声
chapters.action: 风从乱流中找到旋转节拍，大片碎片进入不同半径的回旋轨道。

chapters.title: 散落的光重新相认
chapters.action: 24片几何碎片逐片沿弧归位，94秒完成双层十二瓣光冠，并迎来明亮绽放。

chapters.title: 夜空有了回信
chapters.action: 大光冠舒展为开阔光翼，中央星核与左右长线保持完整的几何构图。

chapters.title: 风的回信
chapters.action: 末句轮廓变成大标题，结语轮廓随之展开；安定的光翼与风带陪伴片名停留。
